Name: THROW_COUNTER_PARAM_ST
Description: Throw counters: matches the acting character and the other character, and gives each a script value while the counter is active.

Fields.Name: Acting Character ID
Fields.Description: The character that triggers the counter against the Character ID; both must match for the row to apply. Retail: 0 (the player) on every row.

Fields.Name: Character ID
Fields.Description: Character ID (model number) of the other character in the counter: the row applies when Acting Character ID and this both match. Retail: the enemy (for example 2100 Black Knife Assassin), with the player as the acting character.

Fields.Name: Acting Character Script Value
Fields.Description: Value given to the acting character's behaviour script while the counter is active. Its use there is not established. Retail: 202600 on every row.

Fields.Name: Target Script Value
Fields.Description: Value given to the other character's (Character ID's) behaviour script while the counter is active. Its use there is not established. Retail: 8550 on every row (an SpEffect ID exists with this number).
